title: Conditional κ = 0.001330733966732373: cross-copy idle-axis hosting, one residual on two copies of one idle child (+5.13% over #447)
body:
Conditional **κ = 1330733966732373/10¹⁸ ≈ 1.330733966732373·10⁻³**, bit-bound, **+5.13 % over #447** (1.265848755025709·10⁻³, complex-bound), +7.53 % over #442 and +17.44 % over #434. Neither local word changes: complex #433 (R = 560, m = 73), bit #434 (R = 747, m = 64). The idle windows are #442's.

## Change

In #442's idle-axis hosting a whole helper residual sits inside the pending coordinates of one data family. Bit residuals have width 8 − e (637 of width 8, 104 of width 7, 6 of width 4) and complex residuals width 9, while the idle children have ranks 7/14/28/42 (bit) and 8/16/32/48 (complex). A rank-7 child cannot hold a width-8 residual, a rank-14 child holds one and wastes six coordinates, and so on: 6,944 of the 45,360 pending bit coordinates per replica and 5,760 of 51,840 complex ones stay idle and are paid as remainder children.

A child acts on every copy (side, port) of its pair, and all copies share the child's window. This package lets a residual lie across the pending sets of **two copies of the same idle child**. With P = P₁ + P₂ the identity D_{P₁}·D_{P₂} = D_P (the parents' D_{P'}·D_{P−P'} = D_P) writes the dirty invocation's factor on the residual as a product of a factor on each family; each is moved to the child exactly as in #442 §2, since the window is a property of the pair; and each child's remainder is exact by #442's fact (b). Every child's capacity, copies × rank, is then a multiple of the residual width, so the remainders almost vanish. A residual never spans two children or two pairs. The route is still an elementary coordinate permutation of the address space; the finite invoice charges one further route factor per helper selector.

The selection is an integer programme over counts n(child, stage, width) on the concatenated tape of each child's copies (maximise Σ ln(m/r) × hosted coordinates, subject to availability and, on the bit side, exact width-64 tiling of the leftover). `SELECTION.json` freezes it; `--discover` recomputes it with scipy.

## Result

| supplier | #442 saving | this saving | live stock | hosted residuals (split) | max child |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bit, m = 64, R = 747 | 1.239085·10⁻³ | **1.332507·10⁻³** | 9,457 → 8,592 | 46,160 of 53,784 (12,496) | 24 |
| complex, m = 73, R = 560 | 1.267453·10⁻³ | **1.437532·10⁻³** | 8,400 → 7,680 | 40,320 of 40,320 (13,720) | 48 |

Both rank deficits stay 2496. The bit max child 24 is one partial copy of a rank-28 child; the complex max child 48 is the 133 copies per replica of the rank-48 final children that the complex supply cannot fill (5,040 residuals against 5,760 width-9 slots per replica). Since #447 is complex-bound at 1.267453·10⁻³, the complex component here should also lift #445/#447's eleven-stage bit words; that composition is not claimed.

## Validation

`python3 -B research/cross-copy-hosting/verify.py /absolute/new/output` (Python 3.11+, standard library only; the output directory must not exist). It

1. runs #434's complete verifier from scratch;
2. regenerates both hosted templates from #434's fresh outputs and the frozen selection;
3. runs an independent audit that shares no code with the generators: windows re-derived from each schedule; for every replica and invocation exactly one owner record per helper; every hosted residual has one or two pieces on copies of the child it names, widths summing to the residual width, inside the pending set, pairwise disjoint per (child, copy), inside the window and off the active pair; exact remainder children and bank tilings; profile, live stock and deficit 2496 recomputed; twelve mutation controls rejected (including a split across two children and a split whose widths do not sum to the residual width);
4. prices both suppliers with the two inherited rational moment engines and fresh finite invoices (prefix 226 bits charged 256, two-level coefficient 488 bits charged 512, row coefficient 18,355 < 20,161; complex row coefficient 15,443);
5. runs #434's strict outer assembly: six bootstrap levels and all 47 inequalities, with the next grid point and the zero-η, zero-β and unit-β controls rejected.

Local transcript: `PASS_FULL_CROSS_COPY_HOSTING_COMPOSITION` on macOS (Apple silicon), Python 3.14.3, 5 min 48 s including the full #434 replay; every value equals `EXPECTED.json` and both template hashes match. CI is not claimed before it runs.

## Scope

This is a written finite extension of #442's hosting interface: a helper residual's physical slot may lie in two data families of one idle child. That is the principal new review point; [PROOF.md](research/cross-copy-hosting/PROOF.md) gives the argument from the parents' two facts. #442's own extension (helper residuals on data streams during idle windows) and all inherited interfaces remain assumptions: the all-size compiler, correlated dirty-bank and compressed-window interfaces, restored work, tape/common grid, precision and analytic transfer. The global operator identity is argued and checked combinatorially, not replayed numerically on the address spaces. No Lean proof and no unconditional integer-multiplication theorem is claimed.
